outcome.implementation_change: ECI now verifies up to eight exact selected-session ambient owner-result Store records against their record digest and linked result identity, within a one-second pre-read budget. It exposes per-result integrity status and bounded aggregate coverage through the existing ambient service-execution trace and service-accountability summary.
outcome.verified_change: The final focused capability-intelligence module passed 173 tests, the repository suite passed 1,150 tests with 82 skipped, the eight-step vertical proof passed, and the paired live ECI readback verified all seven recorded owner results under the bounded check.
outcome.interpretation_limit: The improvement adds traceable integrity evidence. It does not establish service correctness, agent receipt, reduced agent intervention, or generalize beyond this selected-session readback.

pressure_hypothesis.title: Ambient owner-pass result pointers are not checked by the service-accountability projection
pressure_hypothesis.subsystem: MNCS Environment ECI ambient service execution
pressure_hypothesis.basis: The baseline projection made exact owner-result pointers visible without projecting a content-integrity check. The implementation adds only bounded source integrity evidence and keeps correctness, fulfillment, receipt, and burden separate.
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Observe future sessions to determine whether this relationship remains discoverable and whether integrity checks support useful investigation without exceeding their declared resource budget.
not_measured: agent receipt or use of the new field

improvement_relation.basis: The regression suite covers digest and result-identity mismatch, foreign-session non-read, the eight-check cap, the pre-read time budget, compact projection preservation, and separation from correctness and fulfillment. A paired readback of the same active session contrasts the main projection with the implementation projection.
not_measured: whether the projection changes subsequent agent behavior

measurement_limits: The full repository suite ran before the final budget-specific regression was added; the final focused suite includes that regression.
The 82 skipped tests remain unverified under their skipped conditions.
The live evidence covers one session and does not establish an improvement in service fulfillment or agent burden.
